title: System-independent diagnosis: isolate, test and swap

videos.script: The last lesson placed a network fault with four questions. This one is the same method with nothing about networks in it. {{method}} It works on a computer that will not start, a program that crashes, a printer nobody can find and a car that will not turn over, because it is not knowledge about any of those. It is a way of spending your attention. {{attention}} Four moves, and they are the whole lesson. Say what the symptom actually is, which is harder than it sounds. Cut the chain in half rather than guessing at one end of it. {{half}} Change one thing at a time, and write down what you changed. And swap in something known to be good, which is the only move here that turns a suspicion into a fact. {{swap}} None of this makes you faster at the problems you already know. It makes you able to finish the ones you have never seen, which is every problem you will meet after this course.
